integrity: Determinant and count identities proved by graph incidence/cofactor and explicit labeled component counting; independent finite exact-integer replays are supplied.
scientific_limitations: Fixed canonical real (7,28) ETF, all seven-vector subframes; no universal ETF theorem or smallest singular value estimate. Literature priority may be affected by unindexed specialized tables.
title: The exact seven-vector Gram-volume spectrum of the \(28\)-line equiangular tight frame
